messages:
maria_cs: Quick pulse on AcmeCorp account — running the weekly health pass. Noticing an uptick in 5xx + connect timeouts starting Tue 19:00Z. Can we triage? :eyes:

alex_engineer: I pulled the dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/acmecorp/failure-trends — spike aligns with a burst of long-context requests. Top failing paths are /v1/generate (65% of 5xx) and /v1/embeddings/batch (22%).

jamal_ops: healthbot already opened an incident: CH-423. Initial logs show repeated upstream 502 and some ECONNRESET on the embeddings worker pool. Snippet:
```
2026-03-18T19:10:12Z ERROR 5xx handler=invoke trace_id=0a1b2c status=502 path=/v1/generate latency_ms=1285
2026-03-18T19:10:13Z WARN  upstream_connect_timeout path=/v1/embeddings/batch
2026-03-18T19:11:03Z ERROR rate_limit token_bucket_exceeded path=/v1/generate
```

sara_se: also seeing a small bump in rate-limited responses for the same customer key (AcmeCorp-prod). Rate limit window shows a few sustained bursts from a scheduled job that doubled request size last week. That will push up errors and spend.

maria_cs: noted. Renewal risk call next week — flagged for RM. We should capture whether this is a transient surge vs. systemic regressions.

alex_engineer: quick triage notes / suggested runbook:
- Roll forward a canary with increased worker replica for embeddings pool.
- Temporarily tighten prefix caching for long-history sessions (drop kv-cache TTL to 30s for the customer).
- Throttle large batch embeddings via request-size cap at edge (4096 tokens) and queue with backpressure.
- Add short-term model fallback for /v1/generate to a cheaper, lower-latency variant.

jamal_ops: Exec steps I'm doing now:
1) Scale embeddings replicas + restart pool (in progress).
2) Patch gateway to 4096 cap for AcmeCorp-prod (deploying).
3) Add tracing for sampled failing requests (trace_id list to follow).

healthbot: Automated alert: CH-423 created by health-monitor. Current summary: 5xx rate + timeouts + rate_limit increase for AcmeCorp. Severity: high. Links: https://redwood.internal/incidents/CH-423

maria_cs: Can someone drop a short set of customer-facing talking points once we have root cause? I want to tell them what we fixed and actions to avoid recurrence (rate-limit suggestions + batching guidance).

alex_engineer: Will prepare a 3-bullet note. If scaling and caps resolve errors in next 30m, mark as mitigated and draft message. If not, we'll open a dedicated rollback plan.

sara_se: Also recording spend signal — daily token spend for AcmeCorp jumped 48% the same window. I'll include cost impact in the RM note.

maria_cs: Thanks all. Please add short updates here as you do steps. :thumbsup:

jamal_ops: scaled replicas -> done (1749493205). Gateway cap deployed (1749493278). Continuing to monitor.

alex_engineer: early metrics: 5xx rate down 60% post actions, timeouts dropping. Will keep monitoring for 2h then draft customer note.

healthbot: CH-423 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring.
